title: Messages over time: cache hit and miss
description: Lifelines, activation and alternative fragments explain who sends each message and in what temporal order. This is a sequence model rather than a process graph.

data.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant L as Learner
    participant A as App
    participant C as Cache
    participant D as Database
    L->>A: Open lesson
    activate A
    A->>C: Look up lesson
    alt Cache hit
        C-->>A: Cached lesson
    else Cache miss
        C-->>A: Not found
        A->>D: Read lesson
        D-->>A: Lesson data
        A->>C: Store lesson
    end
    A-->>L: Display lesson
    deactivate A
